clue.text: The way to reduce traveling time!…

definitions.text: The way to reduce traveling time!…

parts.words: The way to reduce traveling time
parts.note: a quicker route trims the journey, read as a whole description

explanation.definitionFit: A quicker route that saves travelling time is exactly what this means.

clue.text: He's put in the stocks, this wartime criminal. He should be!

definitions.text: He's put in the stocks, this wartime criminal. He should be!

parts.words: He's put in the stocks, this wartime criminal. He should be
parts.note: a wartime stockpiler of rationed goods puts things in stock, and deserves the old punishment stocks

explanation.surface: A wartime criminal is put in the stocks, and rightly so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stocks' plays on stockpiled supplies and the wooden pillory; in wartime rationing, stockpiling scarce goods was an offence.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who illegally stockpiles scarce goods during rationing is a wartime offender of this kind.

clue.text: You'll get tick if you are just

definitions.text: tick
definitions.meaning: a tick mark shows an answer is correct

definitions.text: just

explanation.surface: Be fair and you will earn a tick of approval.
explanation.definitionFit: Correct (as a tick shows) and fair or just are both senses of this word.

clue.text: Making bacon? Well, that'll be the result of doing it

definitions.text: Making bacon?
definitions.meaning: pork is salted or smoked to make bacon

definitions.text: Well, that'll be the result of doing it
definitions.meaning: treating an illness successfully makes the patient well

explanation.surface: Bacon is being made, and the outcome will be fine.
explanation.definitionFit: Salting meat for preservation and restoring someone to health share this one word.

clue.text: Allows us to enjoy the flavour of food some tongue!

definitions.text: Allows us to enjoy the flavour of food some tongue!

parts.words: Allows us to enjoy the flavour of food some tongue
parts.note: a sensory organ on the tongue lets us perceive flavour

explanation.surface: Something on the tongue lets us enjoy what we eat.
explanation.definitionFit: These sensory receptors on the tongue detect flavours in food.

clue.text: A gun short in the cavalry

definitions.text: A gun short in the cavalry

parts.words: A gun short in the cavalry
parts.note: a short-barrelled rifle was the traditional weapon of mounted troops

explanation.surface: The cavalry is running low on guns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' looks like 'lacking' but describes the gun: a short rifle carried by mounted soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A short light rifle originally issued to cavalry troopers.

clue.text: She takes orders from the board room, as it were!

definitions.text: She takes orders from the board room, as it were!

parts.words: She takes orders from the board room, as it were
parts.note: board is an old word for a dining table, so the board room is a restaurant's dining room

explanation.surface: A woman obeys instructions handed down by company directors.
explanation.walkthrough: The boardroom suggests company directors; here a 'board' is a table laid with food, and the orders are diners' food orders.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman serving at tables takes diners' orders for food.

clue.text: … And cost of getting the right horse

definitions.text: horse

parts.note: a charge is a price or cost

explanation.surface: Continuing on from 1 Across: what you pay to get the correct horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A warhorse ridden into battle by a knight goes by this name.

clue.text: Like the sheriff, took the lead in a Western, for instance

definitions.text: Like the sheriff
definitions.meaning: a sheriff wears a star-shaped badge

definitions.text: took the lead in a Western, for instance
definitions.meaning: the lead actor in a film is its star

explanation.surface: The sheriff's actor played the lead in a cowboy film.
explanation.definitionFit: Wearing a star badge, and having had the leading role in a film, both fit this word.

clue.text: Time taken to cross it, or it may be gained

definitions.text: Time taken to cross it, or it may be gained

parts.words: Time taken to cross it, or it may be gained
parts.note: crossing the international boundary in the Pacific loses or gains a calendar day

explanation.surface: A journey across something takes time, or perhaps saves it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Time taken' looks like journey duration; it means a day lost when crossing the international line one way, gained the other.
explanation.definitionFit: The international meridian where the calendar date changes by a day.

clue.text: First-class explosive about to cause pollution

definitions.text: pollution

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the explosive goes round the first-class piece

parts.note: TNT is the familiar explosive trinitrotoluene
A1 means first-class, with the 1 read as an I

explanation.surface: A top-grade explosive is about to cause contamination.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (first-rate) is written AI, with the figure 1 read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Contamination or a corrupting trace is a synonym for pollution.

clue.text: It's bitter to relinquish part of the sweetness of childhood

definitions.text: part of the sweetness of childhood

parts.note: acid means sour or bitter
to drop something is to give it up

explanation.surface: It is sad to give up a part of childhood's sweetness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweetness' means sweets here: the answer is a sharp-tasting boiled sweet, an old British children's favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: This sour boiled sweet was a classic of British childhood sweet shops.

clue.text: A substitute for the vicar's help

definitions.text: A substitute for the vicar's help

parts.words: A substitute for the vicar's help
parts.note: a junior clergyman assists the vicar and stands in for him

explanation.surface: Someone stands in to help the vicar.
explanation.definitionFit: An assistant parish priest who helps and deputises for the incumbent.

clue.text: The amount of money taken or made by the pastrycook

definitions.text: The amount of money taken
definitions.meaning: a firm's total takings over a period

definitions.text: made by the pastrycook
definitions.meaning: a folded pastry case with filling, such as apple

explanation.surface: How much a pastrycook takes or makes.
explanation.definitionFit: A business's gross revenue, and a folded fruit pastry, share this word.

clue.text: Mournful amusement: a Scottish dance. How ridiculous!

definitions.text: Mournful

parts.note: fun means amusement

indicators.note: an exclamation that something is absurd, telling us to jumble these letters

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance

explanation.surface: Gloomy entertainment at a Scottish dance: how absurd!
explanation.walkthrough: 'How ridiculous' reads as a comment on the scene but tells you to jumble A with the dance; the definition is the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloomy and solemn, as befits a burial service.

clue.text: Creative artist arranges Roman Catholic love-poems

definitions.text: Creative artist

indicators.note: arranging puts the following letters into a new order

parts.note: love is O, the zero score in tennis, followed by poems

explanation.surface: An artist sets Catholic love poetry to a new arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arranges' suggests music, but it shuffles RC, O and POEMS.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of music is a creative artist.

clue.text: Gloomy Moslem is upset, but snaps out of it

definitions.text: snaps out of it

parts.note: dark means gloomy

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: a Moor is a Muslim of North Africa

explanation.surface: A gloomy Muslim is distressed but recovers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snaps out of it' looks like recovering, but means photographs come out of the room where film is developed.
explanation.definitionFit: Photographic prints are developed in this unlit room, so snapshots emerge from it.

clue.text: Liar (cad, too) to reform — that's what he wants…

definitions.text: Liar (cad, too) to reform — that's what he wants…

indicators.note: reforming means changing shape, so the letters are remade into a new order

explanation.surface: A political extremist wants liars and cads made better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To reform' rearranges LIAR and CAD; and reform is what this political figure wants.
explanation.definitionFit: A political extremist seeking sweeping reform.

clue.text: Ideal position for the Rear Admiral?

definitions.text: Ideal position for the Rear Admiral?

parts.words: Ideal position for the Rear Admiral
parts.note: taking 'rear' literally, his natural place is at the back of the ship

explanation.surface: Where should a senior naval officer stand?
explanation.definitionFit: Behind or at the back of a ship, the nautical term for rearwards.

clue.text: Entertainment where precarious seating is all part of the fun

definitions.text: Entertainment where precarious seating is all part of the fun

parts.words: Entertainment where precarious seating is all part of the fun
parts.note: riders try to stay seated on bucking broncos at this show

explanation.surface: A show where wobbly seats add to the enjoyment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Precarious seating' suggests rickety benches, but it is the cowboy's seat on a bucking horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy contest show of bronco riding and roping.

clue.text: Unusually quiet impresario; I aim to get out and do well

definitions.text: do well

indicators.note: something done unusually is done differently, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
these are the letters taken out of the pool

explanation.surface: An unusually quiet showman aims to leave and succeed.
explanation.walkthrough: P and IMPRESARIO are shuffled with I, A, I, M removed ('to get out'), leaving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrive or flourish means to succeed financially.

clue.text: An animal

annotationWithheld.why: An animal (5): too short for the answer; the clue appears cut short in the source

clue.text: Out of work linesmen given a job by the Union

definitions.text: Out of work linesmen given a job by the Union

parts.words: Out of work linesmen given a job by the Union
parts.note: strikers stand in lines at the gate on union orders

explanation.surface: Unemployed linesmen get jobs through the union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of work' means on strike, and the 'linesmen' stand on a picket line, not on a sports touchline.
explanation.definitionFit: Striking workers posted by a union to stand outside a workplace.

clue.text: Naturally, it's how we see Americans in race to get to the office!

definitions.text: Naturally, it's how we see Americans in race to get to the office!

parts.words: Naturally, it's how we see Americans in race to get to the office
parts.note: Americans run for office where the British stand, so a candidate is in a race

explanation.surface: Americans racing to work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Office' is political office: an American candidate runs, a British one stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Being a candidate in an election, in American usage.

clue.text: On it, do nothing to improve the constitution

definitions.text: On it, do nothing to improve the constitution

parts.words: On it, do nothing to improve the constitution
parts.note: a treatment of idleness for one's health, constitution meaning bodily health

explanation.surface: Doing nothing will improve a nation's constitution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constitution' suggests politics; it means physical health.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical regime of rest and inactivity to restore health.
